text: I had braces done here a long time ago, almost two years ago. It was time for my appointment to remove the braces, but I felt my upper front teeth weren't quite aligned enough; they still looked slightly protruding. I wanted them to be more aligned. Also, the midline of my lower front teeth wasn't straight, making them look crooked to the left. I mentioned this to the doctor, and his response was, "Even if you continue wearing the braces and wait for the midline to straighten, it will never be perfectly straight," and he even said my face was crooked to begin with!!! Seriously? How can it be straightened if you don't do any additional adjustments with elastics or bending? He should have explained the situation with reason and given the patient some information, or used a better approach. He should have listened to the patient's opinion instead of just considering his own perspective. I paid for braces, and I want it to be perfect. I shouldn't be told that straightening them will make them look natural. What was the point of wasting my time and money if he doesn't listen? Now I have to get braces a second time at a different clinic.
